tools.description: Create an autonomous AI agent on the user's Fine Structure account: a standing worker, not a chat session. It gets the platform's default safe tool policy and its own email address, it can read and write the app database, and once the owner phone is verified (see get_agent_whatsapp) it can message its owner on WhatsApp and by email through the platform system channels. Pair it with schedule_agent_task for recurring work such as following up new leads on WhatsApp each morning, watching an app for runtime errors, or sending a weekly summary. Messaging anyone other than the verified owner requires a channel the owner connects in the Fine Structure Studio.

app_id.description: Optional app to attach the agent to; account-level when omitted

description.description: What this agent is responsible for, one or two sentences

name.description: Agent display name (e.g. 'Lead Follow-up'). Auto-derived from role when omitted.

persona.description: Optional working style and tone instructions for the agent

tools.title: Create Agent

tools.title: List Agents

tools.description: Create a scheduled task for one of the user's agents. Supported schedule types: once (run_at ISO local time + timezone), interval (interval_minutes 5-1440), hourly, daily (time HH:MM + timezone), weekly (time + timezone + days_of_week 0=Sunday..6), cron (5-field expression + timezone), manual (only runs on demand). Returns the normalized schedule and the computed next_run_at so you can read the fire time back to the user in their timezone.

activate.description: Start the schedule immediately (true) or save as draft (false)

agent_id.description: The agent id (from create_agent or list_agents)

instructions.description: What the agent should do on each run, written as instructions to the agent

max_runs.description: Optional cap on total runs (0 = unlimited)

tools.description: Read the WhatsApp state of the connected account: whether the owner's phone is verified, which platform numbers they can connect, and which conversations already route to which agent. Call this first whenever the user asks to talk to an agent on WhatsApp, and repeat its next_step to them.

agent_id.description: Optional: report only this agent's WhatsApp state.

tools.name: get_agent_whatsapp
tools.title: Get Agent Whatsapp

tools.description: Send a 6-digit code over WhatsApp to the ACCOUNT OWNER's own phone. This is the one-time ownership proof required before a platform number can be connected, and it also unlocks agents messaging the owner. Ask the user for their own WhatsApp number first and send only to that. No WhatsApp Business account is involved.

phone.description: The owner's own WhatsApp number, ideally in E.164 form such as +972501234567.

region.description: Optional ISO region hint (for example IL, US) used when the number has no country code.

tools.name: start_owner_phone_verification
tools.title: Start Owner Phone Verification

tools.description: Confirm the 6-digit code the owner received on WhatsApp from start_owner_phone_verification. On success the owner is verified: agents can message them, and platform numbers become connectable.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the WhatsApp message.

phone.description: The same phone number the code was sent to.

region.description: Optional ISO region hint, matching the one used when sending.

tools.name: confirm_owner_phone_verification
tools.title: Confirm Owner Phone Verification

tools.description: Connect a platform WhatsApp number to one of the account's agents, so the owner can message that number and reach that agent. Requires the owner to be verified first. Take phone_number_id from get_agent_whatsapp. A number already used by another account is still valid to connect: it answers only this owner's verified phone.

agent_id.description: The agent that should answer on this number.

tools.name: attach_agent_whatsapp
tools.title: Attach Agent Whatsapp

tools.description: Disconnect the owner's WhatsApp route from a platform number. Removes only this account's route; other accounts sharing the number keep theirs.

phone_number_id.description: The number to disconnect, from get_agent_whatsapp.

tools.name: detach_agent_whatsapp
tools.title: Detach Agent Whatsapp
